tests.name: two native paper workers and grouped complete-source reviews run concurrently without mixing results
a reported factual problem is repaired by the generation channel and checked again before saving
checked notes contain the short finding and AI tag without changing human read labels or PDFs
classification suggestions are durable but do not move items without confirmation
native confirmation changes only inbox/target membership and preserves other classifications
a human note change blocks a stale classification proposal without overwriting edits
malformed review retains its draft and presents a direct continue button in the native queue
the queue continue action reuses the draft and source, then saves and suggests classification without reimport

scope: Synthetic PDFs, parsed text, CLI responses and collections in isolated headless Zotero; actual transactions, settings and queue buttons exercised.
